messages:
maria (ML): Quick alert 1: q4b-int4 shows regressions on our extra-long summarization set (8k+). median ROUGE dropped ~0.06 and hallucination flags jumped. guessing something with large-kv state handling :frowning:
jordan: Oof. do we have minimal repros? a couple anonymized examples would help triage
maria (ML): pasted one (sanitized):
```
SRC: <8k_article_truncated>
REF: factual summary (3-5 bullets)
Q4B_OUT: invents a conference + wrong year, adds unrelated actor
Q8_OUT: closer to ref, minor omission
```
Also saw sudden token growth in attention mem usage at ~3.5k position.
sam: runtime change yesterday toggled the new kv_compaction heuristic. default now kv_compact=true with threshold=0.55. could that evict earlier and cause stale past context?
maria (ML): that aligns. the kv_compact flip was on the canary pool for int4 tests.
dina: we should expand the long-summary verification set before any rollout. current 'anchor' long summaries are tiny. propose we collect 600 long candidates across domains (news, docs, legal, medical) and curate down to ~300 golds.
kevin: plan for dedupe: token shingling Jaccard >0.58 OR embed cosine >=0.90 => mark as dup. follow with automated span overlap check. then manual spot-check ~2% random.
labeler-bot: queued 600 tasks to labeler/longsummary_candidates (ETA 72h). :robot_face:
jordan: for labeling rubric please keep it compact: (A) Factual errors flagged, (B) Unsupported assertions highlighted, (C) Missing key facts noted. two pass workflow: primary + reviewer.
maria (ML): canary idea: run a 2x2 matrix: q4b-int4 with kv_compact=true/false and q8 baseline with same flags. script: `./run_ab.py --models q8,q4b-int4 --flags kv_compact=true,false --prompts long_cands.csv --metrics rouge,faithfulness,precision`
sam: I'll wire that and include per-prompt diffs. also add hallucination_score (heuristic) and tokenized attention footprint metric.
dina: labelers also add short rationale sentences for flags to help triage (one-liners). keep each item <3 mins.
kevin: after dedupe should be ~360 unique candidates. i'll push the deduped set to `labeler/longsummary_curate` once done.
maria (ML): alert thresholds: if q4b-int4 vs q8 delta_median_rouge <= -0.05 OR delta_halluc_rate >= +0.04 then pause rollout and revert runtime kv_compact on the canary. owner: sam to flip rollback.
jordan: small ablation request: test q4b-int4 with only model quant differences (no runtime changes) to isolate cause.
sam: will include that arm. will start runs tonight.
labeler-bot: dedupe step completed: 600 -> 373 after fuzzyhash+embed check. moving 373 to labeling queue.
dina: timeline: dedupe+prep today, labeling 72h, canary runs start tomorrow evening, preliminary dashboard Thu AM.
maria (ML): please add a few synthetic hard-multi-hop prompts (3-5) to the set to stress hallucination types. also document in tracker: https://redwood.company/s/ops/int4-long-summ-tracker (private).
kevin: noted. i'll add domain tags and a provenance field per item so we can sample by origin for retro analysis.
jordan: thanks team. if results clearly point to kv_compact, sam can revert on canary and we re-run. otherwise we might need small model-side mitigation (calibrated context dropout).
maria (ML): agreed. goal: ship updated gold set + either runtime toggle or model patch by EOW. :thumbsup:
